title: Nemo Foundation Remediation

custom_fields.name: Status
custom_fields.description: Ready requires a named human owner, scope, resolved dependencies and observable acceptance. Done requires accepted integrated evidence.

custom_fields.name: Priority
custom_fields.description: Triage importance: P0 stop-ship or foundation blocker; P1 high; P2 normal; P3 low.

custom_fields.name: Area
custom_fields.description: Primary affected subsystem.

custom_fields.name: Goal
custom_fields.description: Outcome the work advances.

custom_fields.name: Size
custom_fields.description: Relative scope; split L before concurrent implementation.

custom_fields.name: Phase
custom_fields.description: Dependency gate in the remediation program; BZ is the collaboration track.

custom_fields.name: Program
custom_fields.description: Lead program; this does not assign a person.

custom_fields.name: Kind
custom_fields.description: Planning classification for user-owned repository issues.

custom_fields.name: Work package
custom_fields.description: Stable proposal identifier (R00-R22, R18.1-R18.6, BZ0-BZ6 or existing issue).

custom_fields.name: Planning window
custom_fields.description: Proposed relative window; no calendar commitment until kickoff.

custom_fields.name: Start date
custom_fields.description: Scheduled start; Schedule basis identifies forecast, committed or actual timing.

custom_fields.name: Target date
custom_fields.description: Scheduled finish/checkpoint; Schedule basis identifies forecast, committed or actual timing.

custom_fields.name: Triage date
custom_fields.description: Date the disposition and priority were reviewed.

custom_fields.name: Risk
custom_fields.description: Delivery/behavior risk of the work, separate from importance.

custom_fields.name: Validation
custom_fields.description: Evidence state; claimed fixes remain visible until their acceptance is established.

custom_fields.name: Surface
custom_fields.description: Required acceptance surface; detailed matrix lives in the issue.

custom_fields.name: Estimate days
custom_fields.description: Owner estimate in working days; empty until estimated, never zero for unknown.

custom_fields.name: Validation owner
custom_fields.description: Accountable reviewer GitHub login; distinct from issue assignee and PR-native reviewers.

custom_fields.name: References
custom_fields.description: Canonical plan, evidence and related issue links; detailed receipt remains in the issue.

custom_fields.name: Exception expiry
custom_fields.description: Required expiry for any explicitly accepted migration exception.

custom_fields.name: Schedule basis
custom_fields.description: Forecast is a planning date; Committed is an owner-agreed deadline; Actual is observed timing.

dependencies: Native blocked-by relationships plus linked acceptance prerequisites in issue bodies
date_policy: User selected September 4, 2026 (America/New_York) as forecast start. Hour-offset planning uses 20:00 EDT as T0. H24 is Sep 5, H240 is Sep 14, and H336 contingency is Sep 18. These dates do not launch implementation or assert committed staffing.
assignment_policy: Preserve existing assignees. Unassigned work remains Inbox or Blocked. One real human owner per claimed task; agent/session/worktree details belong in receipts.
automation_policy: Native auto-add sub-issues is enabled. Other automatic status/closure rules are disabled. Closed issues leave all active views through is:open filtering; merge does not automatically imply runtime acceptance.
repository_projects_tab_link: Unavailable across different owners; canonical issues and default issue repository are configured.
